points.description: Gives the words 'Representative' and 'Concentration' correctly (e.g. 'Representative Concentration ...'), allowing minor spelling errors.
points.partial_credit: Half if only one of the two words is correct or is badly garbled but recognisable.

points.description: Gives 'Pathway' (synonyms such as 'Pathways' accepted) completing the full form 'Representative Concentration Pathway'.
points.partial_credit: Half if a near-synonym such as 'Path' or 'Profile' is given with the first two words correct.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for 'Representative Concentration Pathway' in any minor spelling variation or plural form. Give 1 mark if two of the three words are right or the phrase is partly correct (e.g. 'Representative Concentration Pathways' with one word slightly off, or 'Representative Concentration Profile'). Give 0 for unrelated expansions such as 'Rainfall Concentration Point'.
